name: 奉仕時間とチェックイン
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE Japanese Lighthouse catalog component LH11-0009 奉仕時間とチェックイン. Image1 ORIGINAL Jobber screen has higher priority for proportions, spacing, alignment, button geometry and fine details; Image2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY localized content/layout guide. Image3 approved bus gives white surfaces and forest gradient styling only. The source region is the slim Tracked time/Clock In strip, not the calendar, timeline, navigation or phone frame.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas with one compact white horizontal card, soft rounded corners, subtle neutral border and gentle downward shadow. Logical390x84 proportions at high resolution; keep it short, do not inflate into a dashboard. Left: quiet small Meiryo regular12/16 「奉仕時間」 above stronger Meiryo bold20/28 「00:00」. Right: primary rounded rectangle button 「チェックイン」 with white legible label, comfortable original button proportions and optical alignment. Preserve exactly these two texts/value and one action. There are NO icons in the source time/action strip; do not add a clock, arrow, avatar, calendar, counters or illustrations. Original source details take priority over any rough invented mock geometry.
Original bright-green Clock In is a real primary action, adapted to official smooth135-degree forest gradient #174C36 → #1F6444 at58% → #2D8F5E. Gentle light edge, restrained depth, no neon or plastic gloss. Value black #1D1D1D, label #6E6E6E, tracking0; preserve Japanese Meiryo and existing role scale, no extra title. No other accents because no statuses or categories are shown. No mint fill, broad tint, colored background or English chrome. Static raster design candidate only; do not show running time or invented activity.
reviewNotes: 原画の時間/右主要操作の帯を優先し、日本語奉仕時間/00:00/チェックインを保持。元の緑主要操作を森林緑グラデへ適応。原画にアイコンなし、追加なし。コンパクトな白面/整列/切れなしを実画像確認。タイマー動作・書体同定・実チェックインは未検証、画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
